2_Introduction: The device shows the highest PCE of 18.7818% with negligible hysteresis, a VOC of 1.087 V, a JSC of 23.818 mA/cm² and a FF of 72.5424%. Commencing with a Cs0.1FA0.9PbI2.8Br0.2 solution at 1.5 mol/L, the perovskite precursor was meticulously formulated. Then the filtered perovskite precursor was spin-coated on the substrate at 1000 rpm for 10 s and 4700 rpm for 30 s. Anti-solvent (200 µL) was dropped on the film at 8 s before the end of the spinning. The deposited perovskite films were subsequently annealed on a hotplate at 115 °C for 30 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The high-performance Cs₀.₁FA₀.₉PbI₂.₈Br₀.₂ perovskite film—engineered with a precisely tuned 1.5 mol/L precursor concentration, dual-step spin-coating (1000 rpm/10 s followed by 4700 rpm/30 s), and critically timed antisolvent quenching (200 µL at 8 s pre-spin-end)—exhibits optimized crystallization kinetics that suppress premature nucleation while enabling rapid, homogeneous intermediate phase formation and subsequent grain growth; this protocol yields large, oriented grains with minimized interfacial voids and suppressed Pb⁰/I⁻ vacancy clusters, directly reflected in the absence of residual PbI₂ peaks in XRD and uniform, high-intensity photoluminescence mapping across the film surface—evidence corroborated by grayscale intensity homogeneity (>92% coverage) and low spatial variance in PL lifetime decay slopes, indicating suppressed non-radiative recombination pathways and enhanced carrier diffusion length. The A-site cation mixture (Cs⁺/FA⁺) improves structural tolerance factor (t ≈ 0.96) and thermal-phase stability, while Br⁻ alloying fine-tunes the bandgap (~1.62 eV) and mitigates halide segregation under operational stress, and the controlled annealing at 115 °C for 30 min fully volatilizes residual DMSO/DMF without inducing δ-phase formation or excessive ion migration, thereby locking in low lattice strain (narrow XRD FWHM of the (110) peak) and high crystallinity. Collectively, these processing parameters synergistically govern nucleation density, crystallographic orientation, and defect thermodynamics—suppressing deep-level traps at grain boundaries and surfaces—leading to balanced charge extraction, reduced interfacial recombination, and exceptional photovoltaic metrics: VOC of 1.087 V, JSC of 23.818 mA/cm², FF of 72.5424%, and PCE of 18.7818%.
